blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 对复杂任务的多个代理人进行管束,需要协调本地子任务执行与全球任务规划. 动态调度方法提供了执行的灵活性,但没有明确模式子任务分级或依赖性,而预定义的工作流程强制这种结构,但在执行开始前固定分解. 因此,我们引入了HTN-Orchestrate,这是一个通过分级任务网络(HTN)来划分这些责任的双层框架. 规划师保持子任务分级和依附关系,将分解延迟至获得先决条件结果后再进行,而当地的Orchestrators则安排工人执行每个叶子任务. 结果在\textbf{AND} 语义下向上传播, 当当前分解无法解决任务时, 累积的结果会告知重建的任务网络 。 在涵盖网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流程的五个基准上,HTN-Orchestrates ReAct, Agent Team,以及DeepSeek Harness使用同一基模型,在浏览器Comp和SUPERChem的精确度分别为89.73%和73.44%,分别超过Agent Team的2.45%和4.69%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on challenging reasoning tasks ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Hubert et al., 2026 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) , and by integrating with external tools, LLM-powered agents ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Agashe et al., 2025 ) can proactively acquire information and revise actions in response to observations. Multi-agent systems ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Steinberger and OpenClaw Community, 2026 ; Nous Research, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) further extend this approach by organizing agents into complementary roles that distribute investigations, explore independent approaches, and verify candidate solutions. Directing these activities toward a common goal requires orchestration ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Ruan et al., 2026 ) , which must reconcile local subtask execution that responds to emerging findings with global task planning that maintains a structured decomposition and tracks dependencies across subtasks.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在挑战推理任务(Yang等人,2023年;Hubert等人,2026年;Novikov等人,2025年)中表现出了强大的表现,并通过与外部工具的结合,LLM动力代理 (姚等,2023;王等,2025;阿加谢等,2025)可以主动获取信息并修改行动,以回应观测. 多代理系统(Wu等,2024;Steinberger and OpenClaw Community,2026;Nous Research,2026;Anthropic,2025;Anthropic,2026b) 将这种方法进一步扩大,组织代理机构发挥互补作用,分配调查,探索独立方法,并验证候选解决方案. 指导这些活动实现共同目标需要协调(Zhang等人,2025c;Ruan等人,2026年),这必须协调地方次级任务的执行,以响应新出现的结论,同时进行全球任务规划,保持结构分解,跟踪各次级任务之间的依赖性。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : HTN-Orchestrate separates result-informed task planning from local multi-agent orchestration. (a) The Planner expands ready tasks using prerequisite results and synthesizes parent results after all children return. When rebuilding is needed, supported evidence is retained to construct a new task network. (b) Each executable leaf is delegated to an Orchestrator, which dispatches workers, collects reports as they become available, and uses those reports to guide subsequent assignments and leaf synthesis. The leaf result returns to the task network for further planning and upward synthesis.
blocks.zh: 图1:HTN-管弦乐团将基于结果的任务规划与当地多代理管弦乐分开. (a) 规划员利用先决条件结果扩大已准备好的任务,并在所有儿童返回后综合父母的成果。 在需要重建时,保留有支持的证据来建造一个新的任务网络。 (b) 每个可执行的叶子都委托给一个Orchestrator,由它派遣工人,随时收集报告,并利用这些报告指导后续任务和叶子合成。 叶子结果返回任务网络进行进一步规划和向上合成.

blocks.en: Existing approaches address orchestration through structured workflows or runtime delegation, but each sacrifices one side of this tradeoff. Structured workflows organize tasks into stages connected by explicit control flow, specifying when agents act and how they exchange results ( Hong et al., 2024 ; LangChain, 2026 ) . Whether authored manually or generated automatically as in AFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , these workflows impose clear global structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins, so that findings from local execution cannot reshape subsequent planning. Runtime delegation addresses this rigidity by having a central orchestrator determine subtasks and assign agents as execution proceeds ( Fourney et al., 2024 ; Ruan et al., 2026 ) , with agent-team approaches ( Kimi Team, 2026a ; Apodex Team, 2026 ) further extending this to parallel subagent dispatch. However, this design couples task decomposition, subtask dispatch, and result synthesis within a single orchestrator ( Ruan et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) , without explicitly modeling subtask hierarchies or precedence dependencies among sibling subtasks. Although dynamic decomposition methods such as ADaPT ( Prasad et al., 2024 ) and ReAcTree ( Choi et al., 2026 ) allow the plan to evolve during execution, they too provide limited support for representing complex dependencies, leaving the tension between adaptive local execution and structured global planning unresolved.
blocks.zh: 现有办法通过结构化的工作流程或运行时间授权来解决协调问题,但每一种办法都牺牲了这种权衡的一面。 结构化的工作流程将任务组织成由明确的控制流相连接的阶段,指定代理行为的时间和如何交换结果(Hong等,2024;LangChain,2026.). 这些工作流程无论是像AFlow(Zhang等,2025b.)中那样手动还是自动生成的,都强加了明确的全局结构,但在执行开始前固定分解,因此本地执行的发现无法重塑后续规划. 运行时代表团通过由中央管弦乐团决定子任务并指定代理作为执行收益来解决这种僵化问题(Fourney等,2024;Ruan等,2026),并采用代理-团队方法(Kimi Team,2026a;Apodex Team,2026)进一步将这项工作扩展到平行的副代理调度. 然而,这种设计夫妻任务分解,分任务调度,以及结果合成在一个单管管管内(Ruan等,2026;Kimi Team,2026a; Zhang等, 2025c.),没有在兄弟子任务中明确建模子任务分级或优先依赖. 虽然ADAPT(Prasad等,2024年)和ReAcTree(Choi等,2026年)等动态分解方法使得计划在执行期间得以发展,但它们也为代表复杂的依赖性提供了有限的支持,留下了适应性局部执行和结构化全球规划之间的紧张关系未解决.

blocks.en: We introduce HTN-Orchestrate 1 1 1 The implementation of HTN-Orchestrate is available at https://github.com/ycdeng-ntu/htn-orchestrate , a two-layer orchestration framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN) ( Erol et al., 1994 ) . At the upper layer, the Planner expands the task network incrementally as prerequisite results become available, so that subsequent decomposition decisions reflect information obtained during execution. At the lower layer, each executable leaf subtask is delegated to an Orchestrator that schedules workers (e.g., researchers, verifiers) and uses their reports to guide investigation, verification, and synthesis. Results propagate upward through the task network under AND semantics, whereby each leaf subtask returns the result produced by its Orchestrator, while each non-leaf subtask synthesizes its result after all its children have completed. The framework also incorporates a rebuilding mechanism that constructs a new task network conditioned on partial results from the previous epoch when execution fails or there is no plausible solution under the current task network.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍HTN-Orchestrate 11 1 HTN-Orchestrate的落实情况,可查阅https://github.com/ycdeng-ntu/htn-orchestrate,这是一个通过分级任务网络(HTN等,1994年)划分这些责任的双层管弦框架。 在上层,规划师在获得先决条件结果后,逐渐地扩展了任务网络,这样之后的分解决定就反映了在执行过程中获得的信息. 在下层,每个可执行的叶子任务都委托给一个Orchestrator,负责安排工人(如研究人员、核查人员),并利用他们的报告指导调查、核实和合成。 成果通过语义下的任务网络向上传播,每个叶子任务返回其Orchestrator产生的结果,而每个非叶子任务则在完成所有子任务后合成其结果. 该框架还包含一个重建机制,构建一个新的任务网络,条件是执行失败或现有任务网络下没有可行的解决办法时,前一时期的部分结果。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows. • We propose HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer orchestration framework (Figure 1 ) that decouples global task planning from local subtask execution through a hierarchical task network that explicitly represents subtask hierarchies and precedence dependencies. The Planner incrementally expands the network as prerequisite results become available, while each executable leaf subtask is delegated to an Orchestrator that coordinates multiple workers. • We combine result-informed planning, which defers decomposition decisions for dependent subtasks until prerequisite findings are available, with AND-semantic synthesis that propagates results upward through the task hierarchy, and a rebuilding mechanism that retains supported evidence from completed work to construct a revised task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. • We evaluate HTN-Orchestrate on five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows and demonstrate that it consistently outperforms Agent Team ( Apodex Team, 2026 ) and DeepSeek Harness ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) . In particular, HTN-Orchestrate achieves 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively. Ablations on BrowseComp demonstrate the contributions of result-informed planning, local multi-agent orchestration, and task-network rebuilding.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下。 我们提出HTN-Orchestrate,一种双层管弦乐框架(图1),通过明确代表子任务等级和优先依赖性的分级任务网络,将全球任务规划与地方分任务执行脱钩. 规划员在取得必要结果后逐步扩大网络,而每个可执行的叶子任务则委托给协调多个工人的Orchestrator。 我们把基于成果的规划与通过任务等级向上传播结果的And-semotic合成相结合,后者将依附子任务的分解决定推迟到获得先决条件后再进行,而后者则把从已完成工作中获得的支持证据保留下来的重建机制结合起来,在目前的分解无法解决任务时,建立一个订正的任务网络。 我们评价HTN-Orchestrate在网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流程等5个基准,并表明它的业绩始终高于代理团队(Apodex Team, 2026年)和DeepSeek Harness(DeepSeek-AI, 2026a年)。 特别是,HTN-Orchestrate在浏览器Comp上达到89.73%的精度,在SUPERChem上达到73.44%的精度,分别超过Agent Team2.45和4.69%. 对浏览器Comp的浏览表明,基于结果的规划、当地多代理组织以及任务网络重建作出了贡献。

The Planner incrementally expands the network as prerequisite results become available, while each executable leaf subtask is delegated to an Orchestrator that coordinates multiple workers.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-Agent Orchestration
blocks.zh: 2.1 多代理管弦乐团

blocks.en: Multi-agent orchestration methods vary in how they distribute responsibilities between global task planning and local execution, and most designs favor one side of this tradeoff. Early frameworks such as AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) organize collaboration through conversation patterns and role-based procedures that provide clear global structure but follow fixed interaction protocols. AFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) and MaAS ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) reduce manual design effort by automating workflow and architecture construction, while Conductor ( Nielsen et al., 2026 ) and MAS-Orchestra ( Ke et al., 2026 ) learn to generate orchestration decisions through reinforcement learning. Although these methods can discover effective coordination patterns, the resulting structures are determined before or independently of task execution.
blocks.zh: 多代理管弦乐方法在全球任务规划和地方执行之间如何分配责任方面各不相同,大多数设计都倾向于这种取舍的一面. 早期的框架如AutoGen(Wu等,2024年)和MetaGPT(Hong等,2024年)通过对话模式和基于角色的程序组织协作,提供清晰的全球结构,但遵循固定的交互协议. AFlow (Zhang等,2025b)和MaAS (Zhang等,2025a)通过将工作流程和建筑建设自动化来减少人工设计努力,而操控者(Nielsen等,2026年)和MAS-管弦乐团(Ke等,2026年)则通过强化学习来学习生成管弦乐决定. 尽管这些方法可以发现有效的协调模式,但由此产生的结构是在任务执行之前或独立确定的.

blocks.en: Runtime delegation shifts toward local adaptability by allowing an orchestrator to assign work as execution proceeds, with Magentic-One ( Fourney et al., 2024 ) and AOrchestra ( Ruan et al., 2026 ) managing task progress through agent feedback. Kimi K2.5 ( Kimi Team, 2026a ) and Apodex 1.1 ( Apodex Team, 2026 ) further support parallel subagents dynamically dispatched by a main agent, and such dispatch decisions can also be learned through policies for agent selection and tool invocation ( Dang et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches couple task decomposition, subtask dispatch, and result synthesis within a single orchestrator, without explicitly separating global planning from local execution management. Workforce, introduced with OWL ( Hu et al., 2025a ) , addresses this by separating a domain-agnostic planner from a central coordinator that manages worker assignments and task dependencies. HTN-Orchestrate shares this separation but assigns a dedicated Orchestrator to each executable leaf subtask, while the Planner maintains and incrementally expands the task network, allowing local coordination within each subtask to operate independently of global planning over the task hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 由Magentic-One(Fourney等人,2024年)和AOrchestra(Ruan等人,2026年)通过代理反馈管理任务进度。 Kimi K2.5 (Kimi Team, 2026a)和Apodex 1.1 (Apodex Team, 2026)进一步支持由主要代理人动态地派出的平行子代理人,这种调度决定也可以通过代理人选择和工具引用政策来学习(Dang等,2025;Su等,2026.). 然而,这些方法将任务分解、子任务调度和结果合成放在一个单独的管弦乐团内,而没有明确地将全球规划与当地执行管理分开。 与OWL(Hu等人,2025年a)共同推出的劳动力,通过将一个领域不可知规划者与管理工人分配和任务依赖的中央协调员分开来解决这个问题。 HTN-Orchestrate共享这种分离,但为每个可执行的叶子任务指派了专门的Orchestrator,而计划员则维持并逐渐地扩展任务网络,使得每个子任务内部的局部协调能够独立于任务层级的全球规划运行.

blocks.en: 2.2 Task Decomposition
blocks.zh: 2.2 任务分解

blocks.en: The tension between local execution and global planning is particularly evident in task decomposition, where the challenge is determining not only how to break a task apart but also when to revise that breakdown in response to execution findings. Static approaches commit to a full decomposition before observing results. Least-to-most prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) generates subproblems before solving them sequentially, and Agent-Oriented Planning ( Li et al., 2025 ) accounts for agent capabilities when decomposing and allocating tasks. D-CORE ( Xu et al., 2026 ) uses reinforcement learning to incentivize decomposition reasoning in large reasoning models, and Select-Then-Decompose ( Liu et al., 2025 ) chooses a decomposition strategy according to the task. These methods improve the quality of decomposition but still finalize it before execution begins.
blocks.zh: 地方执行与全球规划之间的紧张关系在任务分解方面尤其明显,在分解方面,挑战不仅在于决定如何将一项任务分开,而且在于何时根据执行结果修改这一分解。 静态方法承诺在观测结果之前进行全面分解。 最小到最起催化作用(周等,2023年)先产生子问题再相继解决,Agent-Oriented Planning(李等,2025年)在分解和分配任务时会说明代理能力. D-CORE(Xu等,2026年)在大型推理模型中采用强化学习来激励分解推理,而Select-Enter-Decompose(Liu等,2025年)根据任务选择分解策略. 这些方法提高了分解的质量,但仍在行刑前敲定.

blocks.en: When intermediate findings affect subsequent work, decomposition must also adapt during execution. Plan-and-Act ( Erdogan et al., 2025 ) trains models on planning trajectories and revises the plan after each executor step, ADaPT ( Prasad et al., 2024 ) recursively decomposes tasks that resist direct execution, ReCAP ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) revises the remaining plan using execution results, and ReAcTree ( Choi et al., 2026 ) organizes execution through hierarchical agent trees. TodoEvolve ( Liu et al., 2026 ) extends adaptation to the planning architecture itself by learning to generate and revise task-specific planning systems. These methods allow plans to evolve but provide limited support for explicitly modeling precedence dependencies among subtasks. HTN-Orchestrate uses prerequisite results to inform the further decomposition of dependent subtasks, deferring decisions about their internal structure until the relevant evidence becomes available.
blocks.zh: 当中间结论影响后期工作时,分解在执行过程中也必须适应. Plan-and-Act(Erdogan等,2025年)在规划轨迹方面培训模型,并在每次执行步骤后修改计划,ADAPT(Prasad等,2024年)递归分解了抵制直接执行的任务,ReCAP(张等,2025年d)利用执行结果修改了剩余的计划,ReAcTree(Choi等,2026年)通过分级代理树组织执行. TodoEvolve(Liu等,2026年)通过学习生成和修订特定任务规划系统,将适应扩展至规划架构本身. 这些方法使计划得以演变,但为明确模拟次级任务之间的优先依赖性提供了有限的支持。 HTN-Orchestrate使用先决条件结果为附属子任务的进一步分解提供参考,推迟对其内部结构的决定,直到获得相关证据。

blocks.en: 2.3 Hierarchical Task Networks and Dependency-Aware Planning
blocks.zh: 2.3 分级任务网络和依赖性-知情规划

blocks.en: Explicit dependencies connect global planning with local execution by determining which results must be available before subsequent work can proceed. Hierarchical task networks represent complex activities through task decomposition and constraints on the resulting subtasks ( Erol et al., 1994 ) , and recent work such as ChatHTN ( Muñoz-Avila et al., 2025 ) combines this tradition with language models by interleaving LLM-based decomposition with symbolic HTN planning. At a different level of granularity, LLMCompiler ( Kim et al., 2024 ) constructs dependencies among function calls to schedule parallel execution, whereas FlowSearch ( Hu et al., 2025b ) models research as an evolving graph of interdependent knowledge units and dynamically revises its structure in response to intermediate findings. HTN-Orchestrate distinguishes the parent-child relation that defines a decomposition from precedence dependencies among sibling subtasks. The former determines how results are synthesized upward after all children complete, while the latter determines which prerequisite results are available for further decomposition and execution. Each executable task then invokes an Orchestrator that can organize multiple workers, combining hierarchical decomposition, result-informed planning, and local multi-agent coordination within a common execution process. Table 1 summarizes the feature differences between HTN-Orchestrate and the most closely related systems.
blocks.zh: 明确的依赖性将全球规划与当地执行联系起来,方法是确定在随后开展工作之前必须获得哪些成果。 等级任务网络通过任务分解和对由此产生的子任务的制约(Erol等,1994年),代表了复杂的活动,而最近的工作如ChatHTN(Muñoz-Avila等,2025年)通过将基于LLM的分解与象征性的HTN规划相交而将这种传统与语言模型相融合. 在不同的颗粒度水平上,LLMCompiler(Kim等,2024年)在函数之间构建了依赖性,需要安排平行执行,而FlowSearch(Hu等,2025年b)模型研究则作为相互依存的知识单位不断演变的图表并动态地修改其结构,以应对中间发现. HTN-Orchestrate区分了父子关系,它定义了兄弟子任务之间的分解与优先依赖关系. 前者决定在所有儿童完成后如何向上合成结果,而后者则决定哪些先决条件结果可供进一步分解和执行。 然后,每个可执行的任务都援引一个Orchestrator,可以组织多个工人,将分级分解,结果知情规划,以及当地多代理协调等在共同执行过程中结合起来. 表1总结了HTN-Orchestrate与最密切相关的系统之间的特征差异.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given a task q q and a set of worker roles and tools, HTN-Orchestrate separates global task planning from local subtask execution through two cooperating layers (Figure 1 ). At the upper layer, the Planner incrementally constructs a hierarchical task network that encodes subtask decompositions and their dependencies, while at the lower layer, each executable leaf subtask is delegated to an Orchestrator that schedules workers and returns a result. Because these results flow back to the Planner, subsequent decomposition decisions reflect findings that were unavailable when the network was first constructed, and when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task, accumulated evidence supports the construction of a revised network.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个任务q和一套工人角色和工具,HTN-Orchestrate通过两个合作层面(图1)将全球任务规划与地方次级任务执行分开。 在上层,规划师递增地构建了一个分级任务网络,将子任务分解及其依赖性编码,而下层则将每个可执行的叶子任务委托给一个安排工人和返回结果的Orchestrator. 由于这些结果会流回"规划师",后来的分解决定反映了网络初建时没有的发现,当目前的分解无法解决任务时,所积累的证据支持了经过修改的网络的建设.

We denote the children and direct prerequisites of v v by Ch ⁡ ( v ) \mathrm{Ch}(v) and Pred ⁡ ( v ) \mathrm{Pred}(v) , respectively. Unlike classical HTN planners that draw from a predefined library of decomposition rules, our Planner uses an LLM to generate decompositions during execution, which allows the network to grow incrementally as prerequisite results become available.

blocks.en: 3.2 Result-Informed Planning
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果规划

blocks.en: The Planner uses prerequisite execution results to guide subsequent task decomposition and retains accumulated findings to support replanning, as summarized in Algorithm 1 . For each ready leaf, PlanOrExecute \mathrm{PlanOrExecute} considers the original goal, the task description, its ancestors, and summaries of relevant prerequisite results, and based on this context either marks the task for direct execution or expands the network with children and their sibling dependencies. Because a dependent subtask receives its decomposition only after its prerequisites return, its internal structure can reflect their findings rather than relying on assumptions made before execution began. For example, a task that first identifies a research subject can supply its result to a subsequent analysis task, whose decomposition can then target that subject’s specific properties (Figure 5 illustrates this on a web-research question where identifying a set of authors allows the Planner to specialize the downstream search to that specific list). Each proposed decomposition is validated for coverage of the parent task and acyclicity of the proposed dependency edges, and revised if either check fails. Depth and branching limits further control overall network growth.
blocks.zh: 规划员使用先决条件执行结果来指导随后的任务分解,并保留累积结果以支持重新规划,如算法概述 1 (英语). 对于每片已准备好的叶子,PlanOrExecute\mathrm{PlanOrExecute}会考虑原始目标,任务描述,其祖先,以及相关前提结果的总结,并以此为上下文标出直接执行的任务或者将网络与儿童及其兄弟的依赖关系扩大. 因为一个附属子任务只有在其先决条件返回后才能得到分解,所以其内部结构可以反映他们的调查结果,而不是依赖执行开始前所作的假设. 例如,首先确定一个研究对象的任务可以将其结果提供给随后的分析任务,然后分析对象的分解可以针对该对象的特定属性(图5在网络研究问题中说明了这一点,其中确定一组作者可以使规划者将下游搜索专门到该特定列表中去). 每项拟议的分解均经过验证,以涵盖上级任务和拟议依赖边缘的循环,如果检查失败,则加以修订。 深度和分支限制进一步控制整个网络增长.

blocks.en: When execution fails or the returned findings indicate no plausible solution under the current task network, the Planner can reconsider the decomposition through replanning. Each construction and execution of a task network constitutes an epoch , and before starting a new epoch the Planner settles or stops ongoing work and uses CollectEvidence \mathrm{CollectEvidence} to extract supported findings from completed and partial reports into an evidence summary M M . This summary conditions the construction of a new network rooted at the original task, providing planning context rather than automatically marking any new subtask as completed, so that the next epoch can pursue a different decomposition while retaining useful evidence. The number of rebuilds is bounded, and the framework terminates through one of two paths. When the root node is resolved, its synthesized result is returned directly as the final answer. When execution budgets are exhausted before the task is resolved, the framework instead synthesizes the evidence obtained so far and reports any unresolved requirements, so the output reflects the sufficiency of the evidence rather than treating the stopping condition as task success.

blocks.en: 3.3 Multi-Agent Orchestration
blocks.zh: 3.3 多代理管弦乐团

blocks.en: For each executable leaf v v , an Orchestrator manages the workers needed to address that subtask (Algorithm 2 ). Workers carry out targeted research, reasoning, or verification using their configured tools, while the Orchestrator decides how the investigation should proceed based on their reports. Each Orchestrator receives a stable context C v C_{v} containing the original task, the leaf’s objective, relevant ancestor descriptions, and prerequisite result summaries, and during execution it maintains the set of returned worker reports R v R_{v} and active assignments A v A_{v} .
blocks.zh: 对于每个可执行的叶子vv, Orchestrator管理解决该子任务(agorithm 2 ) 所需的工人。 工人使用他们配置的工具进行有针对性的研究、推理或核查,而Orchestrator则根据他们的报告决定如何进行调查。 每个Orchestrator收到一个稳定的上下文C v C_{v}包含原始任务,叶子的目标,相关的祖先描述,以及先决条件的结果摘要,在执行期间它保持了一套返回的工人报告Rv R_{v}和活的任务Av A_{v}.

blocks.en: At each decision point, the Orchestrator considers C v C_{v} , R v R_{v} , and A v A_{v} and chooses to dispatch workers, wait for progress, or finish the subtask. A dispatch decision selects worker roles and produces task-specific instructions based on the current evidence, so an initial investigation can be followed by a focused search or a verification step when a report reveals a gap or a disputed claim. Reports are collected as workers finish, allowing the Orchestrator to schedule follow-up work while other assignments remain active, or to wait for new reports when the outstanding questions are already covered. This progressive collection of results allows local decisions to respond to evidence within a wave, while limits on concurrency, dispatch rounds, and execution time bound the work assigned to each subtask.
blocks.zh: 在每一个决定点,Orchestrator都考虑C v C_{v},R v R_{v}和A v A_{v}选择派遣工人,等待进步,或者完成子任务. 发件决定选择工人角色,并根据现有证据提出具体任务指示,因此在初步调查之后,当报告显示存在漏洞或有争议诉求时,可以进行重点搜索或核查步骤. 报告是在工人完成后收集的,使Orchestrator能够安排后续工作,而其他任务仍在执行中,或者在未决问题已经涉及时等待新的报告。 这种渐进式的成果收集使得当地的决定可以在一波内对证据作出反应,而货币的限制,发包周期,以及执行时间则将分配给每个子任务的工作捆绑起来.

blocks.en: Once the Orchestrator decides to finish, it stops work that is no longer needed and synthesizes the collected reports into a leaf result that includes a summary, a resolved or unresolved outcome, and evidence references. If an execution limit is reached before a voluntary finish, the Orchestrator collects available reports within the remaining time and returns the supported findings together with any outstanding gaps. In both cases, the outcome reflects the sufficiency of the evidence rather than merely whether workers stopped or a verifier was invoked, and the Planner uses the returned result to inform subsequent decomposition through PlanOrExecute \mathrm{PlanOrExecute} and parent synthesis through PropagateResults \mathrm{PropagateResults} .
blocks.zh: 一旦Orchestrator决定完成,它就会停止不再需要的工作,并将所收集的报告合成一个叶子结果,其中包括一个摘要、一个已解决或未解决的结果以及证据参考。 如果在自愿完成之前达到执行限制,则Orchestrator在所剩时间内收集现有报告,并将所支持的调查结果与任何尚未填补的空白一并退回。 在这两种情况下,结果都反映了证据的充足性,而不仅仅是工人被停止或被援引核查人,而计划者利用返回的结果通过PlanOrExecute\mathrm{PlanOrExecute}告知随后的分解情况,并通过PropagateResults\mathrm{PropagateResults}告知母体合成情况。

blocks.en: 4 Empirical Evaluations
blocks.zh: 4 经验评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate HTN-Orchestrate on five benchmarks covering web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows. BrowseComp (BC) ( Wei et al., 2025 ) tests an agent’s ability to locate hard-to-find information through persistent web browsing. For scientific reasoning and research, we use both tracks of FrontierScience ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , with FrontierScience-Research (FSR) comprising open-ended research subproblems and FrontierScience-Olympiad (FSO) assessing olympiad-level reasoning in physics, chemistry, and biology. We use the text-only subset of 256 questions from SUPERChem ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) to further evaluate multistep reasoning across chemistry subfields, while PRL-Bench ( Miao et al., 2026 ) extends the evaluation to theoretical and computational physics research tasks derived from published papers. We report accuracy for BC, FSO, and SUPERChem, where answers can be directly verified against ground truth. For the rubric-based benchmarks, we report the success rate for FSR, defined as the fraction of responses earning at least seven of ten rubric points, and the mean percentage of satisfied rubric criteria on a 0–100 scale for PRL-Bench.
blocks.zh: 我们评价HTN-Orchestrate的五个基准,包括网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流程。 BurrowsComp (BC)(Wei等人,2025年)测试了一种代理人通过持续的网页浏览查找难以找到的信息的能力。 在科学推理和研究方面,我们使用 " Frontier Science " (Wang等,2026年)的两条轨道, " Frontier Science-Research " (FSR)包括开放式研究子问题和 " Frontier Science-Olympiad " (FSO),评估物理学、化学和生物学中的 " Olympia " 级推理。 我们利用来自SUPERChem(赵等,2025年)的256个问题中仅有的文本子集来进一步评价跨化学子领域的多步推理,而PRL-Bench(Miao等,2026年)则将评价扩展到了从所发表的论文中衍生出来的理论和计算物理研究任务. 我们报告BC、FSO和SUPERChem的准确性,可以直接根据地面真相核实答案。 对于基于主题的基准,我们报告FSR的成功率,定义是至少获得10个分数中7个分数的回复的分数,以及对于PRL-Bench来说,在0-100比例上满足主题标准的平均百分比。

blocks.en: We compare HTN-Orchestrate with the ReAct and Agent Team workflows implemented in FrontierAgent ( Apodex Team, 2026 ) . 2 2 2 https://github.com/ApodexAI/FrontierAgent The ReAct baseline ( Yao et al., 2023 ) uses a single agent that alternates reasoning and tool use, incorporating observations into subsequent actions. Agent Team uses a main agent to decompose the task, dispatch subagents in parallel, and integrate their reports as execution proceeds. We also include DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) , DeepSeek’s official agent runtime in Minimal Mode, a single-agent configuration with a persistent shell and file editor, to which we add web search tools for BrowseComp.
blocks.zh: 我们把HTN-管弦乐团与FrontierAgent(Apodex Team,2026年)执行的ReAct和代理团队工作流程进行比较. 2 2 2 https://github.com/ApodexAI/FrontierAgent ReAct基线(Yao等人,2023年)使用一种单一的代理,替代推理和工具使用,将观察纳入后续行动. Agent Team使用主干员来分解任务,同时派遣子干员,并将他们的报告作为执行收益进行整合. 我们也包括DeepSeek Harness(DSH)(DeepSeek-AI,2026a),DeepSeek的官方代理运行时间为"最小模式",一个具有持久外壳和文件编辑器的单代理配置,我们为它添加了浏览Comp的网页搜索工具.

blocks.en: All four methods use DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as the backbone model with high reasoning effort. In HTN-Orchestrate, workers instead use low reasoning effort and operate in two complementary roles for research and verification. Their available tools include web search, webpage retrieval, scholarly search, Python execution, file reading, and report submission, though search and retrieval are disabled for FSR, FSO, SUPERChem, and PRL-Bench. To bound network growth and execution cost, we set the maximum task-network depth to two (counting the root at depth zero) with at most four children per node, and within each executable subtask allow up to three concurrent workers over at most twelve orchestration rounds per epoch, while the Planner can rebuild the task network once during execution. Appendix A lists the full execution settings, evaluation judges, and measurement definitions.
blocks.zh: 所有四种方法都以DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为主干模型,并有很高的推理努力. 在HTN-Orchestrate中,工人则采用低推理努力,在研究和核查方面发挥两个互补作用。 其现有工具包括网页搜索、网页检索、学术搜索、Python执行、文件阅读和报告提交,虽然FSR、FSO、SUPERChem和PRL-Bench的搜索和检索被禁用。 为了限制网络的成长和执行成本,我们把最大任务网络深度设定为两个(以深度为0计算根),每个节点最多有四个孩子,在每个可执行的子任务中,每个节点最多有3个同时工作的人,最多12个管弦乐轮,而计划者可以在执行期间重建一次任务网络. 附 录 A列出了全部执行设置、评价法官和衡量定义。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: HTN-Orchestrate outperforms all three controlled baselines on every benchmark and is competitive with frontier proprietary models despite using DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, an open-weight model, as its backbone (Table 2 ). On BrowseComp, it achieves 89.73% accuracy, exceeding ReAct by 15.80 percentage points and Agent Team by 2.45 points. Only GPT-6 Astra (91.50%), Kimi K3 (91.20%), and GPT-5.6 Sol (90.40%) score higher, all of which are frontier-scale models. Agent Team, which dispatches subagents without hierarchical planning, already exceeds ReAct by 13.35 points, confirming that multi-agent execution is broadly beneficial for persistent web research. The additional 2.45-point gain from HTN-Orchestrate over Agent Team reflects the contribution of structured decomposition and result-informed planning.
blocks.zh: HTN-Orchestrate在每一个基准上都超过了所有三个受控基线,尽管使用了DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(开放量级模型)作为其主干,但与前沿专有模型具有竞争力(表2)。 在浏览器Comp上,其精度达到89.73%,超过ReAct15.80个百分点,代理团队达到2.45分. 只有GPT-6 Astra(91.50%),Kimi K3(91.20%),和GPT-5.6 Sol(90.40%)的得分较高,都是前沿尺度模型. 代理团队(Agent Team)在没有分级规划的情况下派出副代理,已经超过ReAct13.35分,证实多代理执行对持续进行网络研究大有裨益. 从HTN-Orchestrate多于Agent Team获得的2.45分的额外收益反映了结构分解和成果知情规划的贡献.

blocks.en: On the two open-ended research benchmarks, HTN-Orchestrate achieves the highest scores among all models in Table 2 . On FSR, it reaches a success rate of 43.33%, surpassing Meta Muse Spark (38.00%), GPT-5.5 (33.90%), and Agent Team (40.00%). The 18.33-point margin over ReAct and 3.33-point margin over Agent Team suggest that separating global task planning from local worker coordination allows the framework to manage the iterative hypothesis refinement that open-ended research demands. PRL-Bench reinforces this pattern, with a mean rubric score of 46.00 exceeding the next-best result from Gemini 3.1 Pro (44.27) by 1.73 points, while the 10.19-point gain over Agent Team is the largest on any benchmark.
blocks.zh: 在两个不限成员名额的研究基准上,HTN-Orchestrate在表2的所有模型中都取得了最高的分数. 在FSR上,成功率达到43.33%,超过了Meta Muse Spark(38.00%),GPT-5.5(33.90%)和Agent Team(40.00%). 18.33分比ReAct差和3.33分比Agent Team差,表明将全球任务规划与当地工人协调分开,使框架能够管理无限期研究要求的迭接假说完善。 PRL-Bench强化了这种模式,平均比分46.00比双子座3.1 Pro(44.27)的得分次高1.73分,而10.19分比Agent Team的得分是任何基准上最大的.

blocks.en: On the two accuracy-based science benchmarks, HTN-Orchestrate remains competitive with much larger proprietary systems. On FSO, it reaches 79.00% accuracy, matching Gemini 3.1 Pro and improving over Agent Team (75.00%) and DeepSeek Harness (76.00%) by 4.00 and 3.00 points. On SUPERChem, it scores 73.44%, falling only 0.16 points short of GPT-5.6 Sol (73.60%), the overall best, while exceeding Agent Team and ReAct by 4.69 and 8.21 points. Across all five benchmarks, gains over Agent Team range from 2.45 points on BC to 10.19 points on PRL-Bench, with the largest improvements appearing on tasks that reward structured decomposition and iterative refinement.
blocks.zh: 在基于准确性的两个科学基准上,HTN-Orchestrate仍然与更大的专有系统具有竞争力. 在FSO上,它达到了79.00 %的精度,匹配了双子座3.1 Pro并比Agent Team(75.00%)和DeepSeek Harness(76.00%)提高了4.00和3.00分. 在SUPERChem上,它得分为73.44%,相差于GPT-5.6 Sol(73.60%)的分数只有0.16分,是总的最好成绩,而Agent Team和ReAct则以4.69分和8.21分相差. 在所有五个基准中,代理人小组的收益范围从BC的2.45分到PRL-Bench的10.19分不等,最大的改进出现在奖励结构分解和反复改进的任务上。

blocks.en: These results also highlight the complementary strengths of multi-agent orchestration and minimal-tooling runtimes. DeepSeek Harness, as a single-agent runtime, outperforms Agent Team on PRL-Bench (39.89 vs. 35.81) and matches it on FSO (76.00 vs. 75.00), showing that a focused single-agent runtime can be competitive on benchmarks that reward sustained reasoning. HTN-Orchestrate outperforms both approaches across all five benchmarks. That it achieves these results with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, an open-weight model, while matching or exceeding larger proprietary systems underscores the importance of orchestration design in determining overall system performance.
blocks.zh: 这些成果还突出了多代理管弦乐和最小工具运行时间的互补优势. DeepSeek Harness作为单代理运行时间,在PRL-Bench(39.89 vs 35.81)上超越代理团队,并在FSO(76.00 vs 75.00)上与之相匹配,显示焦点单代理运行时间可以在奖励持续推理的基准上具有竞争力. HTN-Orchestrate在所有五个基准中都优于这两种方法。 它通过DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(一种开量模型)来达到这些结果,同时匹配或超过更大的专有系统强调管弦设计在决定整体系统性能上的重要性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis

blocks.en: To understand how HTN-Orchestrate’s two-layer design translates accuracy gains into distinct execution patterns, and to isolate the contribution of each architectural component, we conduct execution analysis and ablation studies on a 200-question subset randomly sampled from BrowseComp. The execution analysis examines completion time, worker concurrency, and internal task-network statistics to reveal the operational signatures of hierarchical orchestration, while the ablations disable result-informed planning, local multi-agent orchestration, and task-network rebuilding in turn to quantify their individual effects.
blocks.zh: 为了了解HTN-Orchestrate的两层设计如何将精度的增益转化为不同的执行模式,并隔离每个建筑构件的贡献,我们对从浏览孔普中随机抽取的200个问题子集进行执行分析并进行断裂研究. 执行分析审查了完成时间、工人货币和内部任务网络统计,以揭示分级协调的操作特征,而混合则使成果知情规划、当地多代理协调以及任务网络重建无法进行,从而可以量化其个别影响。

blocks.en: Execution Analysis. The per-question comparisons in Figure 2 reveal how HTN-Orchestrate’s accuracy advantage interacts with completion time. Among the 165 questions both HTN-Orchestrate and Agent Team answer correctly, HTN-Orchestrate finishes faster on 112 (67.9%), with a median per-question completion-time ratio of 0.699 relative to Agent Team, so its time advantage complements its higher overall accuracy. The comparison with ReAct reveals a different tradeoff, as HTN-Orchestrate generally takes longer on questions both methods answer correctly while correctly answering 38 questions that ReAct misses and missing only 12 that ReAct answers correctly, for a net gain of 26 correct answers.
blocks.zh: 执行分析。 图2中的每个问题比较显示,HTN-Orchestrate的准确性优势如何与完成时间相互作用。 在HTN-Orchestrate和Agent Team双方的165个问题中,HTN-Orchestrate在112上(67.9%)完成得更快,每问题完成时间的中位数相对于Agent Team为0.699,因此其时间优势补充了它更高的整体准确度. 与ReAct的比较揭示了一种不同的取舍,因为HTN-Orchestrate在问题上通常需要更长的时间,两种方法都正确回答,同时正确回答38个问题,而ReAct错过了这些问题,而只错过了12个RAct正确回答,净收益为26个正确答案.

blocks.en: To characterize parallel execution, we apply the average-concurrency measure used in performance analysis ( Huang et al., 2010 ) to worker invocations. For each question, average worker concurrency is C ¯ = 1 T ​ ∑ i d i \bar{C}=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{i}d_{i} , where d i d_{i} is the active duration of worker invocation i i within the trace window and T T is the question’s makespan, giving the time-weighted mean number of active workers over the full window including periods with no active workers. Figure 3 compares this measure and the fraction of time spent at different worker counts. Averaged across all questions, worker concurrency is 2.47 for HTN-Orchestrate and 1.70 for Agent Team; on the 165 shared successes, it remains higher at 2.42 vs. 1.82. On this shared subset, HTN-Orchestrate spends an average of 24.6% of each run with at least four active workers, compared with 11.8% for Agent Team, but it also spends a larger fraction of time with no active workers, during which planning, coordination, or synthesis can still proceed. This pattern of concentrated worker activity interspersed with non-worker periods is consistent with its hierarchical organization, which dispatches workers concurrently across executable subtasks, and accompanies the shorter completion times observed on shared successes.
blocks.zh: 为了说明平行执行的特点,我们对工人援引的情况适用业绩分析中使用的平均货币计量(Huang等人,2010年)。 对于每个问题,平均工人货币是C' = 1 T i d i\bar{C}=\frac{1 }{T}\ sum_{i} d_{i d_{i},其中di d_{i}是工人在微量窗口内引用i的活期,T是问题所在,使整个窗口内的时间加权平均在职工人人数包括没有在职工人的时期。 图3比较了这一措施以及在不同工人中花费的时间比例。 在所有问题中,平均工人货币是HTN-Orchestrate2.47和Agent Team1.70;在165项共享的成功中,工人货币是2.42对1.82。 在这个共享的子集上,HTN-Orchestrate每次平均花费24.6%,至少有4名在役工人,而Agent Team则花费了11.8%的时间,但是它也花费了更大的时间,没有在役工人,在此期间仍然可以进行规划,协调,或合成. 这种集中工人活动与非工人活动期相互交织的模式与其等级组织是一致的,这种组织同时派遣工人执行可执行的分任务,同时伴随着在共同成功方面观察到的较短的完成时间。

blocks.en: Within HTN-Orchestrate, Table 3 relates final task structure to the execution activity accumulated across the initial and rebuilt task networks. The two outcome groups have similar final tree depths and leaf counts, while questions scored incorrect involve more leaf executions, worker invocations, and Orchestrator decisions on average. Rebuilding also occurs more frequently in this group, at 50.0% compared with 14.7% for questions scored correct. Similar final task structures therefore correspond to substantially different execution histories, making accumulated orchestration and rebuilding activity important for understanding the research process.
blocks.zh: 在HTN-Orchestrate内部,表3将最终任务结构与整个初始和重建的任务网络所积累的执行活动联系起来。 两个结果组有着类似的最终树深和叶子计数,而得分不正确的问题涉及更多的叶子处决,工人引用,以及平均的Orchestrator决定. 这一组的重建频率也更高,为50.0%,而正确回答的问题为14.7%。 因此,类似的最终任务结构与执行历史大相径庭,使积累的管弦乐和重建活动对理解研究进程至关重要。

blocks.en: The traces also document the use of dynamic decomposition and recovery. The Planner produces child subtasks at nodes with prerequisite dependencies 79 times across 57 of the 200 questions, confirming that result-informed planning occurs regularly during execution. Task-network rebuilding occurs on 35 questions, of which 27 are ultimately scored correct. These runs show that research can continue through a revised task network and reach a correct answer after the original execution encounters a recovery condition.
blocks.zh: 这些痕迹还记录了动态分解和恢复的使用。 规划者在节点制作儿童子任务,在200个问题中,有57个问题具有79倍的先决条件依赖性,证实在执行期间经常进行成果知情规划。 任务网络重建涉及35个问题,其中27个问题最终得到正确评价。 这些运行显示,研究可以通过修改后的任务网络继续进行,并在原始执行遇到恢复条件后得到正确的答案.

blocks.en: Ablation Studies. To isolate the contribution of each component, we evaluate three ablated variants, removing result-informed planning, local multi-agent orchestration, and task-network rebuilding in turn while preserving the remaining mechanisms (Appendix C gives detailed definitions and extended results). All three reduce accuracy (Table 4 ), but with distinct effects on execution behavior (Figure 4 ; counts cover all epochs, with No rebuilding restricted to its single epoch).
blocks.zh: 校勘研究. 为了孤立每个组成部分的贡献,我们评价三个减速变体,取消注重结果的规划、当地多代理安排和任务网络重建,同时保留其余机制(附录C给出了详细的定义并扩展了成果)。 所有三个都降低了准确度(表4),但对执行行为有明显影响(图4;计数覆盖了所有纪元,没有重建仅限于其单一纪元).

blocks.en: Upfront decomposition is the most direct test of the central mechanism because it changes only whether decomposition occurs before or after prerequisite results return, while retaining dependency-based execution, local multi-agent orchestration, and rebuilding. Without current-epoch research results to narrow subsequent decomposition, accuracy decreases from 92.0% to 90.5%. This less targeted planning also increases coordination effort at the median, with worker invocations rising from 14 to 16, Orchestrator rounds from 14 to 17, and the rebuilding rate from 17.5% to 22.5%. Median completion time also rises from 25.23 to 30.02 minutes. The full system therefore achieves higher accuracy with less coordination and lower latency, indicating that intermediate findings guide more effective task decomposition.
blocks.zh: 前分解是中央机制最直接的检验标准,因为它只改变分解是在结果返回之前还是之后发生的,同时保留依赖性执行,当地多剂管弦乐,以及重建. 没有当前时代的研究结果来缩小后续分解,精度从92.0%下降到90.5%. 这种目标较少的规划也增加了中位点的协调工作,招聘工人的人数从14人增至16人,Orchestrator轮从14人增至17人,重建率从17.5%增至22.5%。 中度完成时间也从25.23分增加到30.02分. 因此,整个系统以较少的协调程度和较慢的延迟程度来达到更高的准确性,表明中间结果可以指导更有效的任务分解。

blocks.en: Single-agent leaf execution replaces each leaf’s local orchestration with a single ReAct researcher while retaining HTN planning, synthesis, and task-network rebuilding. Accuracy drops to 89.5%, and although the variant naturally uses fewer workers and makes no Orchestrator decisions, the mean number of executed leaf instances increases from 4.67 to 6.15 per question while the rebuilding rate nearly doubles from 17.5% to 32.0%. Less effective research within individual leaves shifts more of the burden to the Planner, which compensates by spawning additional subtasks and rebuilding more frequently. The full system combines higher accuracy with fewer leaf executions and less frequent rebuilding, highlighting how local orchestration supports global task resolution.
blocks.zh: 单剂活叶执行取代了每片活叶局部的管弦乐,同时保留了HTN的规划,合成和任务网络重建. 准确率下降到89.5%,虽然该变体自然使用较少的工人,并且没有做出Orchestrator决定,但被执行的叶子的平均数量从每个问题4.67%增加到6.15,而重建率几乎翻了一番,从17.5%增加到32.0%。 个别叶子内不太有效的研究将更多的负担转移给规划员,通过产生更多的子任务并更频繁地重建来弥补。 完整的系统结合了更高的精度,更少的叶子处决和更少的重建,突出了局部管弦乐如何支持全球任务解决.

blocks.en: No rebuilding disables task-network reconstruction while preserving result-informed planning within the initial epoch. Accuracy decreases to 89.5%, and because the system can no longer trigger a second epoch, average execution activity also falls, with executed leaf instances dropping from 4.67 to 4.12 per question and worker invocations from 23.16 to 19.01. The full system’s higher accuracy therefore comes at the cost of this additional research, which the rebuilding mechanism makes possible by retaining findings and revising the task network when the initial decomposition cannot resolve the task.
blocks.zh: 不重建会禁用任务网络重建, 同时在最初的时代中保留注重结果的规划 。 准确率降至89.5%,由于系统不能再引发第二个时代,平均执行活动也下降,被执行的叶子事件从每个问题4.67个下降到4.12个,工人引用的次数从23.16个下降到19.01个. 因此,整个系统的准确性较高,而代价是进行这种额外研究,重建机制通过保留调查结果和在最初分解无法解决任务时修订任务网络,使这项研究成为可能。

blocks.en: Case Studies. Figure 5 shows how intermediate findings shape task decomposition on BrowseComp question Q193. After identifying the supplement and its four authors, HTN-Orchestrate incorporates their names into a newly generated task that checks which author wrote a children’s book in 2015. The upfront decomposition variant instead specifies an independent search for children’s-book authors with role-playing-game credits, followed by a separate task to reconcile the two candidate sets. Both runs reach the correct answer, but the result-informed plan narrows the downstream search to the returned author list and executes four leaves rather than five.
blocks.zh: 个案研究。 图5显示在浏览器COMP问题Q193上中间发现如何形状任务分解. HTN-Orchestrate在查明了该补编及其四位作者后,将他们的名字纳入了一项新产生的任务中,该任务检查了作者在2015年写了一本儿童书. 前置分解变体则指定独立搜索有角色扮演游戏学分的儿童图书作者,然后单独进行调和两个候选组合的任务. 两跑都达到了正确的答案,但结果知情计划将下游搜索缩小为返回的作者列表,并执行出四叶而非五叶.

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates task-network rebuilding on Q501. The initial search does not locate the target music-blog post. HTN-Orchestrate retains candidate albums, recurring weekday features, and rejected posts, then rebuilds the network with an additional feature-based search and an explicit album-to-list matching task. Research continues until the post-search branch locates the target article and verifies its song list. The final answer is Serial Killer by Tobin Sprout, while No rebuilding returns Silent Night . blocks.zh: 图6显示Q501上的任务网络重建情况。 初始搜索没有找到目标音乐-博客帖. HTN-Orchestrate保留了候选相册,经常性的周日特写,并拒绝了帖子,然后重建了网络,增加了基于特性的搜索并明确了相册到列表的匹配任务. 研究持续到搜索后分支找到目标文章并验证其歌曲列表. 最后的答案是Tobin Sprout的"连环杀手",而"不重建"则返回"寂静之夜". 附 录 D提出了另一个案例研究,涵盖叶子内的定向核查。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer orchestration framework that separates global task planning from local multi-agent execution. Its upper layer maintains a hierarchical task network that decomposes incrementally as prerequisite findings become available and can be rebuilt when the initial plan proves insufficient, while its lower layer coordinates multiple workers within each executable subtask. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate consistently outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness. Ablation studies on BrowseComp suggest that result-informed planning, local multi-agent orchestration, and task-network rebuilding each contribute to this advantage, with execution traces revealing interdependence between the two layers. These findings show that separating control across two layers while feeding results back through a shared, revisable task structure allows each layer to inform the other and strengthens both. Future work includes scaling the task-network depth for problems that require deeper decomposition hierarchies and evaluating the framework across additional backbone models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了HTN-Orchestrate,这是一个双层管弦乐框架,它将全球任务规划与本地多代理执行分开. 其上层维持着一个分级的任务网络,随着先决条件发现的可获性逐渐分解,并在初始计划证明不充分时可以重建,而其下层则在每个可执行子任务中协调多个工人. 在涵盖网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流程的5个基准上,HTN-Orchestrate一直优于ReAct、Agent Team和DeepSeek Harness。 对浏览器COMP的对比研究显示,注重结果的规划、当地多代理组织以及任务网络的重建,都有助于这一优势,执行的痕迹揭示出两层之间的相互依存关系。 这些调查结果表明,通过一个共享的、可修改的任务结构将控制分出两层,同时将结果反馈给对方,使每个层能够向对方通报情况并增强两者。 今后的工作包括针对需要更深层次分解的问题扩大任务网络深度,并用其他主干模式评价框架。

blocks.en: Table 10 extends the accuracy comparison in the main paper with execution volume and latency measurements. Upfront decomposition uses more executed leaves and workers than the full system and has longer mean and median duration. Removing rebuilding reduces mean duration, although its median duration is slightly higher.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录D 个案研究

blocks.en: D.1 Using an Intermediate Result to Specialize Later Work
blocks.zh: D.1 利用中级结果专门从事以后的工作

blocks.en: BrowseComp Q193 asks for a radio station’s first broadcast year through a chain of clues involving a 1993 role-playing supplement, one of its authors, a children’s book, and the author’s father. The initial investigation identifies Creative Campaigning and returns four authors: Tony Pryor, Tony Herring, Jonathan Tweet, and Norm Ritchie. The Planner then specializes the downstream investigation using this returned list, checking which author wrote the 2015 children’s book and establishing the father’s identity.
blocks.zh: 浏览Computer Q193要求广播电台通过一系列线索进行第一个广播年份,这些线索涉及1993年角色扮演副刊、其作者之一、儿童书和作者的父亲。 初步调查确定了"创意运动"(Creative Campaigning),并归还了四位作者:托尼·普赖尔,托尼·赫林,乔纳森·特韦特和诺姆·里奇. 计划员随后利用这份退回的名单专门进行下游调查,检查谁是作者撰写了2015年儿童书并确定了父亲的身份.

blocks.en: The resulting chain identifies Jonathan Tweet, Grandmother Fish , Roald Tweet, and WVIK, leading to the answer 1980 . The upfront variant also answers correctly, but plans its children’s-book investigation before receiving the author list. Across the complete attempts, HTN-Orchestrate executes four leaves and 15 workers, compared with five leaves and 20 workers for upfront decomposition. This case shows how an intermediate result can make the remaining task more specific even when both methods eventually reach the same answer.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的链条识别出乔纳森·特威特(Jonathan Tweet),外祖母鱼(Grand Madam Fish),罗尔德·特威特(Roald Tweet),和WVIK(WVIK),导致1980年的答案. 但在收到作者名单之前, 在整个尝试中,HTN-Orchestrate处决了4个叶子和15个工人,而5个叶子和20个工人用于前发分解. 这个案例表明,即使两种方法最终都得到同样的答案,中间结果如何能使所余任务更加具体.

blocks.en: D.2 Targeted Verification within a Leaf
blocks.zh: D.2 叶片内的定向核查

blocks.en: BrowseComp Q1025 asks for a conductor identified by a 2008 concert review, a poem-based opening work, and a venue dedicated in the early 1990s. The task network separates identifying the poem, locating candidate reviews, and reconciling the conductor’s identity. Within the review-search leaf, the Orchestrator dispatches complementary review-first, venue-first, and opening-song investigations.
blocks.zh: 浏览器Comp Q1025要求由2008年的演唱会评论所认定的导师,以诗作为主的开场作品,以及1990年代初的专用会场. 任务网络将识别诗作,定位候选评论,调和指挥者的身份. 在审查-搜索叶子内, Orchestrator 发送补充审查-第一,地点-第一,开口调查.

blocks.en: The venue-first report connects the Berger Center, dedicated in 1992, with Reveille Men’s Chorus, conductor Linus Lerner , and the opener Come Travel With Me . The Orchestrator then assigns a verifier to check that evidence chain. The completed attempt uses three leaves and ten workers. The single-agent-per-leaf variant executes nine leaves across two epochs and submits Gregory Wait ; its final explanation does not establish the specific 2008 review connecting that conductor to the requested performance.
blocks.zh: 网站首个报告将1992年的伯杰中心与导师Linus Lerner的Reveille Men Chorus, 然后,Orchestrator指定一个核查员检查证据链。 完成的尝试使用3个叶子和10个工人. 单剂-每叶变体执行跨越两个纪元的9个叶子并提交Gregory Wait;其最后解释没有确定2008年将该导体与所请求的性能联系起来的具体审查.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Local multi-agent orchestration on BrowseComp Q1025. The expanded leaf shows complementary discovery assignments followed by verification of a returned candidate. The full system identifies Linus Lerner; the single-agent-per-leaf variant submits Gregory Wait.
blocks.zh: 图8:浏览器上的本地多剂管弦乐 Q1025. 扩大的叶子显示补充性发现任务,然后核查返回的候选人。 全系统识别出Linus Lerner;单剂-活叶变体提交Gregory Wait.

blocks.en: D.3 Evidence Carried across a Rebuild
blocks.zh: D.3 通过重建收集的证据

blocks.en: BrowseComp Q501 asks for the third song in a 24-song blog list dated 27 December, using clues about a weekly feature and an album. In the first epoch, the investigation fails to recover the required list before a leaf timeout. Recovery retains the findings and unresolved source-identification work, and the next epoch constructs a revised task network.
blocks.zh: 浏览Comp Q501在12月27日的24相声博客列表中询问了第三首歌曲,使用了关于每周特辑和相册的线索. 在第一个纪元中,调查未能在叶子超时前收回所需的列表. 恢复保留了调查结果和未解决的源识别工作,下一个时代将建立一个订正的任务网络。

blocks.en: The second epoch obtains answer-bearing evidence in its post-list branch. When a later timeout ends further execution, recovery finalization uses the accumulated evidence to return “Serial Killer” by Tobin Sprout . The no-rebuilding variant returns “Silent Night.” The full attempt executes five leaves and 72 workers across two epochs, compared with two leaves and 18 workers for no rebuilding. This case illustrates a successful continuation through evidence-preserving recovery, including finalization from the evidence available at the execution limit.
blocks.zh: 第二个纪元在其后列表分支中获得了有答案的证据. 当后来的超时结束进一步执行时,恢复定稿使用所积累的证据将托宾·斯普鲁特(Tobin Sprout)的"连环杀手"送回来. 不重建变体返回“静夜”。 全部尝试在两个纪元间执行5个叶子和72个工人,而2个叶子和18个工人则没有重建. 此案表明,通过保全证据的追回,包括从执行限度内掌握的证据中最终确定证据,继续顺利进行。
